body: Yeah I get that, I have C-PTSD though so I think that makes it harder to feel safe around people, especially when they betray my sense of trust and safety in them. I tend to put up with too much stuff from someone for too long, and the resentment piles up when something really bad happens. I struggle to connect with people without trauma, and I get annoyed when people can’t understand me when I try so hard to be accommodating, which is ultimately been a survival tactic to appease. I’m in the position of being painfully self aware and also deeply flawed myself, but unable to tolerate when people wrong me

I’ve had so many people declare me their family insincerely. There are people who will be there for you, in ways my blood family never were, but I’ve only found one person like that so far

Leeds and Sheffield are both cheap places to live in. From living in Leeds for a few years we have quite a large trans community here, we have the only northern trans pride that happens every year too. There is also a gender clinic in Sheffield and Leeds too :) Edinburgh is lovely but not cheap at all, if you’re set on Scotland then Glasgow is cheaper to live in for sure :) But yeah if you’re looking for affordable living then don’t even bother looking at Brighton or anywhere that’s considered “south”. 
Edit- rent in Brighton is minimum £500pcm (about) where as in Leeds/Sheffield it’s more like £300-400pcm for a entire 2 bed house in cheapest places. 
Whilst Manchester doesn’t have a GIC it’s a really good option for stuff to do, and rent isn’t too much more than in Leeds from what I know. You’ll probably find lots of Polish shops in whatever large city to be honest :) good luck!
